title: Isotopes, Atomic Mass, and Atomic Identity
purpose: Apply atomic structure to isotope and mass reasoning.
labDataRequirement: Isotope abundance and average atomic mass data analysis
safetyNotes: Use isotope data only. No radiation-related activities are performed.
simulationReview: Direct simulation/resource link is provided in P01.html and in directSimulationUrl.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for atomic models, periodic trends, energy levels, and spectra
simulationVirtualLabReviewFocus: Isotope abundance and average atomic mass data analysis
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the isotope activity screen. Use one element and compare at least two isotopes of that element. Change or inspect isotope abundance values and watch how average atomic mass responds. Record isotope symbols, mass numbers, abundance values, calculated or displayed average atomic mass, and the conclusion about atomic identity.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
